sanskrit_verse:
mahokṣaṃ vā mahājaṃ vā śrotriyāyopakalpayet /
satkriyānvāsanaṃ svādu bhojanaṃ sūnṛtaṃ vacaḥ // YajñS_1.109
transliteration: mahokṣaṃ vā mahājaṃ vā śrotriyāyopakalpayet / satkriyānvāsanaṃ svādu bhojanaṃ sūnṛtaṃ vacaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: To the śrotriya, whether a great sacrificer or a great possessor of cattle, one shall offer great oxen or great wealth; or else, respectful hospitality, soft seating, sweet food, and gentle speech.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from Vedic learning and ritual integrity
Causation aligns with sacrificial and social duty fulfillment
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by spiritual and material contribution
Restoration logic prioritizes sustenance and respect for dharma-sustaining roles
Consciousness alignment requires honoring those who uphold Vedic continuity
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent is identified as Shrotriya THEN system MUST allocate resources for sustenance and honor
IF societal role supports Vedic continuity THEN resource allocation MUST include food, shelter, and dignified interaction
IF capacity for sacrifice or knowledge contribution is verified THEN economic support SHALL be provided without condition
IF speech or behavior undermines Shrotriya dignity THEN automatic redirection to restorative engagement protocol SHALL occur
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving scholars or practitioners of Vedic knowledge, the court must prioritize structural support mechanisms that ensure their continued function within society. Responsibility lies not in punishment but in ensuring alignment with national dharmic infrastructure.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes the Shrotriya's entitlement through Vedic action. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential offerings—material, verbal, behavioral. Responsibility flows from recognition of dharmic service. No punitive element exists where alignment with consciousness is maintained through reciprocal respect.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svādhyāya Support Program to sustain Shrotriya livelihood
Deploy Satkriyā Protocol: assign community service roles that honor Vedic presence
Activate Bhojanānanda Initiative: ensure regular provision of nourishing meals
Implement Vāk Yoga Alignment: train public interface agents in non-violent communication towards Shrotriyas
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this directive executes Dharma as non-punitive alignment. The Shrotriya is sustained not by law but by sacred duty reciprocated. Reality remains free of punishment when consciousness governs justice. Dharma is restored.
